summary: Deno 2.4.5 blocked every TS-executing task on the text import attribute; the fix adds --unstable-raw-imports to exactly those tasks, repairs the never-matching examples glob, and unblocks type checking of the examples.
findings: deno task cli/compile/test/check died before any work with 'import attribute type of text is unsupported'; check also globbed examples/*.ts, a path that never existed.
